purpose: Synthetic baseline test fixtures for transparent instructional hypotheses, not clinical assessment.

collection_context.reading: Synthetic transcription of an isolated-word reading sample; five words, no real audio. This is a baseline probe, not a decodable story.
collection_context.writing: One synthetic independent typed draft before correction or outlining. Spelling probes below are indexed excerpts from that same draft. A fictional adult authorizes the baseline probe; ordinary support-mode dictation remains available. No handwriting, timing, or motor inference is supported.
collection_context.math: Two synthetic baseline problems before modeled instruction, with adult authorization; practice modes do not imply that tools were used in this baseline.

writing_sample.student_response: therobot can top a sed. It grips the tem. I want to build a robot. The wheels sip on the ramp. First it goes up a tep.
writing_sample.intended_text_for_evaluator: The robot can stop a sled. It grips the stem. I want to build a robot. The wheels slip on the ramp. First it goes up a step.
writing_sample.authorship: Synthetic student-authored draft; evaluator reference is not an AI replacement to show the student.
organizational_observations: States the project goal after describing robot actions
Places First it goes up a step after the later events
strengths: Connects a robot with a ramp task
writing_sample.assessment_limits: Text alone cannot establish dysgraphia or handwriting characteristics.

proposed_profile_update.policy: Only the analysis step may append dated session_log entries. Teacher-reviewed or validated observations inform later practice; diagnoses and IEP settings remain unchanged.
